result_scope: Observed local working-tree candidate. No hosted changes or owner operations.

commands.tests: cd backend && env FINN_MODEL_PROVIDER=keyless OPENAI_API_KEY= ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= GEMINI_API_KEY= GOOGLE_API_KEY= GROQ_API_KEY= OPENROUTER_API_KEY= ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests
commands.static_build: cd frontend && VITE_STATIC=1 VITE_DIGEST_URL=/finn-enam/digest.json npm run build -- --base=/finn-enam/ --outDir <scratch>/www/finn-enam
commands.seed: scripts/build_seed.py prepare --from-dir data/seed_build_2026_11_04/pack; finn xbrl-refresh --quarters 8; scripts/build_seed.py verify; scripts/build_seed.py pack, all with scratch paths
commands.digest: env FINN_MODEL_PROVIDER=keyless FINN_DATA_DIR=<isolated store> PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/python -m finn digest --days 7 --out <scratch>/digest.json --dry-run
commands.layout: PYTHONPATH=<temporary Playwright install> .venv/bin/python backend/tests/ui_layout.py --static http://127.0.0.1:18085/finn-enam/ --live http://127.0.0.1:18084/ --chrome <installed Chrome> --out <scratch>/layout_report.json
commands.ticker: In a separate scratch seed: App.company('PIDILITIND'); App.submit_research(... mode='live'); App.run_job(job_id); App.refresh_financials(['PIDILITIND']); App.company('ZZZQX').
commands.hygiene: git status --short --branch; git ls-files filtered for prohibited artifacts; git diff --cached --name-only; git diff --check
